C0240.title: Dark Web Child Pornography Distribution Case Involving a University Sophomore Elite Student
C0240.summary: In 2016, a sophomore named Sun used advanced computer skills to access hidden networks and posted content on a forum primarily distributing child pornography videos. He shared over 100 videos, which received more than 20,000 views and over 7,000 replies, earning him a high-level VIP status on the forum before being arrested by police.
